add.title: G1 - Governo publica portaria com direitos para presos gays e travestis (Portaria SDH/PR 419/2014)
add.summary: G1 (17 Apr 2014): the Secretaria de Direitos Humanos da Presidência da República published a federal portaria setting where LGBT prisoners are housed across Brazil's prison system, which applies in Minas Gerais' state system: transsexual men and women must be forwarded to female prison units; gay and travesti prisoners held in male prisons must be offered specific conviviality spaces; LGBT inmates may use their social name (which must appear in the admission record) and choose male or female clothing. No sanctions are provided for non-compliance, and the report documents no Minas Gerais-specific implementation, wing, segregation practice or case.
